put.description: Write a whole control model to a grid location. Replacing keeps the control id; entity ids are regenerated. A layered button may leave out options, style, feedbacks, steps and localVariables, and style elements may leave out properties: defaults fill them in. Every action, feedback and style property is validated first; a 422 lists every problem with its path. Send If-Match to only replace a version you have seen (use "*" to require that a control exists).
